title: Prusa Nozzle-Change Regression
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prusaconnect:printer event=print_complete
| stats avg(first_layer_score) as avg_first_layer_score, avg(failure_pct) as avg_failure_pct by printer nozzle_type
| where avg_failure_pct>5 OR avg_first_layer_score<80
| sort avg_first_layer_score
description: Uses Prusa print-completion telemetry telemetry to monitor quality after nozzle changes or nozzle swaps in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for hardware changes that reduced print consistency, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Prusa print-completion telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Printer and nozzle table of first-layer score and failure rate.
grandmaExplanation: It blends quality after nozzle changes or nozzle swaps so you can spot hardware changes that reduced print consistency before it becomes annoying.
